crawl: Chrome live crawl, same-origin fetch, cache: no-store, sequential per URL, on 2026-10-13 Vietnam time (one-day step from 12 Oct). One crawl pass; the same crawl feeds the SEO report technical-health section.
method: TTFB measured with performance.now() around a sequential fetch of each URL with a 15 s abort. Words counted on a body clone with script/style/noscript/template removed. Schema blocks counted as application/ld+json elements, @type walked through @graph. Internal links are unique same-origin paths per page. MISSING-ALT RULE (in force since 2 Oct 2026): only visible outside

Only CRAWLABILITY moves, 99 -> 98: distinct internal links fall back to 2,711 (22.97 per page; 12 Oct 2,805, 23.77) because the site-wide template link is missing again on 94 of 95 articles (cause inferred, not measured); one article (/articles/3d-rendering-company-melbourne) is now linked only from the hub, 0 orphans. All 118 pages return 200. PERFORMANCE 98 (TTFB mean 315.9 ms, median 261.0 ms, ceiling 639 ms on /articles/house-renovation-3d-design-adelaide, all 118 pages under 1 s). STRUCTURED DATA 98 (116/118 pages with schema, FAQPage 95/95 articles, 407 JSON-LD blocks). ON-PAGE 94 (118/118 one H1, title, meta description, self canonical; 0 images missing alt under the visible- rule).
